# Jingdu Third-Party Attribution

This directory is packaged into the Android APK/AAB as application assets.

## OpenccJava 1.4.2

Project: `laisuk/OpenccJava`
License: MIT
Purpose in Jingdu: local, bounded OpenCC-compatible Chinese phrase conversion.
Full license: `licenses/OpenccJava-MIT.txt`

## Open Chinese Convert (OpenCC) dictionaries/configs

Project: `BYVoid/OpenCC`
License: Apache License 2.0 for the lexicon/config material bundled or repackaged by OpenccJava.
Full license: `licenses/OpenCC-Apache-2.0.txt`

The OpenCC upstream repository root checked for this integration does not contain a `NOTICE` file. A future dependency or dictionary upgrade that introduces NOTICE/additional attribution must update these packaged assets before release.

Jingdu uses these components entirely on-device. Book text is not sent to a third-party service.
